meta.source: Game files 19.17020 (major_gods.xml Kronos timeshifting; techtree.xml TemporalChaos)
meta.note: Kronos building command (not a favor god power, no cooldown). Duration = timeRatio 1.0 x the building's build points (guide: 'duration ratio according to building's build points'), so it does not depend on builders. Cost ratio 0 for Manor, Farm, Economic Guild, Military Barracks, Counter Barracks, Dock, Temple, Armory, Market; 0.50 of the building cost for Palace, Sentry Tower, Mirror Tower. Only these buildings can be shifted (not Town/Village Centers, walls, Wonder). 2 concurrent shifts. Temporal Chaos: duration x0.5, 3 concurrent, cost ratio 0.25 (not modelled). Names: en from STR_PUC_UNBUILD ('Time Shift this building'), pt-BR from STR_HK_TIMESHIFT.
